page_title: RBL 1-2 MAI | RB Leipzig v Mainz 01/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' RB Leipzig failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by RB Leipzig, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' A corner kick by RB Leipzig is thwarted by the well prepared Robin Zentner (Mainz).

90' Robin Zentner pulls off a great save to deny Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the top of the net. The ball is out of play and RB Leipzig manage to earn a corner.
89' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
88' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Lennard Maloney (Mainz).
88' RB Leipzig win a corner.
86' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 10:15.
83' Substitution. Nadiem Amiri makes way for Lennard Maloney (Mainz).
81' The resulting set piece from RB Leipzig is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
81' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by RB Leipzig, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to RB Leipzig.
80' Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Daniel Siebert blows for a foul. That's a free kick to RB Leipzig.
79' Nelson Weiper (Mainz) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
78' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) picks up a pass and fires a powerful long-range shot which goes painfully close to the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
78' That will be all from Arthur Vermeeren who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig).
77' RB Leipzig can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
77' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from David Raum (RB Leipzig). The linesman makes the right call and RB Leipzig will have a corner.

75' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) is furious with himself as he misses a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
75' Here comes a substitution. Jonathan Burkardt is given a rest as he is replaced by Nelson Weiper (Mainz).
75' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) shows off his amazing technique to get in front of goal by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball onto the left post. Nice run, but unlucky finish!
74' Mainz take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
74' The attendance for today's match is 35000.
72' Here is a change. Lois Openda is going off and Marco Rose gives the last tactical orders to Kosta Nedeljkovic (RB Leipzig).
72' The referee signals a substitution. Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) is brought on as a substitute for El Chadaille Bitshiabu.

70' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Kaishu Sano (Mainz), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
67' The percentage of ball possession is – 47:53.
64' Danny da Costa (Mainz) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
61' RB Leipzig seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
59' Marco Rose has decided to substitute Lutsharel Geertruida and he is replaced by Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig).
59' A substitution has been made. Amadou Haidara goes off and Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) comes on.

58' 1 - 2 GOAL! Superb work from Nadiem Amiri, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz), who beats Peter Gulacsi with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 1:2.

55' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes a whisker over the bar! What a huge opportunity! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
52' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) was quite harsh and Daniel Siebert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
52' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Paul Nebel is the provider as he slips the ball to Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) who simply steers it home from close range. It's 1:1.

49' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
49' RB Leipzig force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is able to continue to play.
45+2' The game is interrupted now, Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.

43' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) leaps highest in the middle of the box to meet a lofted ball and powers a header at a goal, but unfortunately for him it flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
40' Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) picks up a loose pass and unexpectedly unleashes a howitzer from distance, but the effort comes to nothing as a defender gets in the block.
38' Mainz are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
35' Paul Nebel (Mainz) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
32' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.

29' Daniel Siebert blows his whistle after Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. It's a free kick to RB Leipzig, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.

27' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball has crossed the sideline. RB Leipzig are taking a throw-in.

23' Close! Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
21' RB Leipzig are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
18' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) offside.
17' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
14' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
11' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig), but Robin Zentner is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
9' Paul Nebel (Mainz) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. It's a throw-in for RB Leipzig.
7' Mainz couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Peter Gulacsi (RB Leipzig) leaped high and intercepted a cross.

5' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
1' 1 - 0 Goal! Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 1:0.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Mainz will have the kick-off.
Daniel Siebert was nominated as the referee for this game.
